name: design
description: Dev-only design canvas at /design: renders components from client/src/design, lets you click-select elements in the canvas or the running app and hand them to a coding agent

builderOrigin.description: Origins of the app builder that embeds the app (e.g. ["https://builder.example.com"]; a single string is also accepted). When /design runs inside that window (iframe parent or opener), each send is also posted to it with window.postMessage. '*' is not allowed.
